target.statement: LOO-LBFP ROC-AUC on the Mixture scenario (mean over 100 replications)

compute.basis: Simulation of 100 samples of size 1000 in 2D, computing a closed-form score and ROC-AUC; no training, no GPU, minimal memory and disk.

blockers: No code released; must implement LBFP estimator and LOODIS from paper description
Simulation details (exact mixture parameters, seeds, bin-width constants) are in Supplementary Materials not included in the PDF
title: A Leave-One-Out Influence Statistic for Density-Based Outlier Detection
